title: How is Nelson Mandela connected to Napoleon?
description: Five photos and two paintings link Nelson Mandela to Napoleon.
hook: How is Nelson Mandela connected to Napoleon?

image.file: File:President George W. Bush and Former President Nelson Mandela of South Africa Meet in the Oval Office.jpg

links.line: In 2005, Nelson Mandela visited George W. Bush in the Oval Office.

image.file: File:President George W. Bush, Former President Gerald Ford and Mrs. Betty Ford Greet the Media in Rancho Mirage, California (P042306ED-1123).jpg

links.line: In 2006, Bush dropped in on Gerald Ford at his home in Rancho Mirage, California.

image.file: File:Mr. and Mrs. Ford and Nixon 13 Oct 1973.jpg

links.line: In 1973, Richard Nixon picked Ford as his vice president; a year later Ford had his job.
In 1970, Nixon threw a White House dinner for Edward the Eighth, the king who gave up his throne.
Back in 1894, baby Edward sat on the lap of his great-grandmother, Queen Victoria.

image.file: File:Edward Matthew Ward (1816-79) - Queen Victoria at the Tomb of Napoleon, 24 August 1855 - RCIN 402019 - Royal Collection.jpg

links.line: This painting shows Victoria in 1855, visiting Napoleon's tomb in Paris with Emperor Napoleon the Third.
And in this 1810 painting, the baby on Napoleon's knee is his nephew, the future Napoleon the Third.
